info.title: Voxcina Backend API
info.description:
REST API of the Voxcina online store (Go backend).

The storefront (`voxcina.com`) proxies every `/api/*` request to this service, so **Try it out** on this page runs against the same origin — no CORS setup needed.

## Authentication

Two security schemes are used:

- **`bearerAuth`** — the JWT access token issued by `POST /api/users/login` (or the OTP flows). Ordinary user endpoints accept any valid token; endpoints marked *Admin* additionally require `role == "admin"` and *Staff* endpoints accept `admin` or `staff` (enforced server-side on every request against the live user record).
- **`serviceApiKey`** — the `X-API-Key` header for server-to-server bot/channel integrations under `/api/auth/external/*` (created by admins in the external-services panel).

Tokens are stateless but every request is re-checked against the database: logout, deactivation, role changes and password changes take effect immediately.

## Response envelope

Successful responses are bare JSON objects (or arrays) whose shape mirrors the Go models. Auth/permission failures return `{"error": "...", "code": "..."}`.

> This document describes the core surfaces of the API. Field-level fidelity is best-effort; the Go models under `models/` are the source of truth.

## Telegram bot integration guide (end-to-end)

You need TWO credentials:
1. **X-API-Key** — ask the shop admin to create a service in the admin panel `/admin/external-services`
   with provider `telegram` and scopes `identity:exchange` + `identity:bind_phone`.
   The key (`vxk_...`) is shown once; all `/api/auth/external/*` calls use it.
2. Per-user JWT — minted by your bot via `POST /api/auth/external/token` (steps below).

Typical flow for each Telegram user:

1. **Register the user**: `POST /api/auth/external/token` with
   `{"provider":"telegram","external_id":"<telegram user id>","profile":{"first_name":...,"username":...},"bot_id":"<bot username>"}`
   → `{token, refreshToken, is_new, has_phone, user}`. A brand-new user is a phone-less
   shadow account (`account_type:"external"`). Store `token` + `refreshToken` SERVER-SIDE.
2. **Keep the session alive**: `POST /api/users/refresh` `{"refreshToken":"..."}` —
   rotating policy: save the NEW refreshToken from every response; presenting an
   already-rotated token revokes the whole family.
3. **Bind a phone (required for delivery + DigiPay)**: `POST /api/auth/external/phone/send-otp`
   → user replies with the code → `POST /api/auth/external/phone/verify-otp`
   (`{"...","code":"12345","merge":false}`). If you get `409 phone_taken` with `can_merge:true`,
   the number belongs to a registered web account — confirm with the user, then retry with
   `"merge":true` to keep one account. Alternative: the contact-share route
   `/api/auth/external/phone/contact`. Old customers can link by code instead:
   they run `POST /api/users/link-code` on the site and give the bot the code
   → `POST /api/auth/external/link`.
4. **Show products**: `GET /api/products?page=&limit=&sort=newest&search=...`
   (public; one row per color variant; `colorVariant.sizes[]` carries stock per size)
   and `GET /api/products/{id}` for detail.
5. **Cart**: `POST /api/cart/item` `{"productId":"...","variant":{"variantId":"...","size":"M","color":"...","colorName":"...","sku":"..."},"quantity":1}`
   → returns the whole cart (`GET /api/cart` anytime; `PUT /api/cart/item` changes quantity;
   `DELETE /api/cart/item?productId=...&variantSize=M&variantId=...` removes).
6. **Address**: `POST /api/users/addresses` `{"city":"...","postal_code":"...","address":"...","latitude":35.7,"longitude":51.4,"phone_number":"09..."}` —
   `GET /api/neshan/reverse?lat=..&lng=..` fills city/province from coordinates.
7. **Order**: `POST /api/checkout` with `items` (each `{"product_id","variant":{"variantId","size","color",...},"quantity"}`),
   `shippingAddress`, and informational totals → returns the order (`status:"pending"`).
8. **Payment**: `POST /api/payment/request` `{"orderId":"...","gateway":"zibal"}` → `{payUrl}` —
   send it as a Telegram inline button. When the user pays, the gateway calls this API back;
   the order becomes `payment_status:"paid"`. Poll `GET /api/orders/{orderId}` (or
   `POST /api/payment/inquiry` `{"trackId":<int>}`) to detect completion. Failed/expired
   payments: `POST /api/payment/retry` `{"orderId":"..."}` mints a NEW attempt + payUrl.
9. **Order history**: `GET /api/orders?page=1&limit=10` (optionally `status=`, `search=`).

Bot-side rate limit: 300 requests/minute per X-API-Key (HTTP 429 `RATE_LIMITED`).
Error bodies always carry a machine-readable `code` (see the `ErrorBody` schema) —
branch on it, do not parse messages.

201.description: User created (no token pair; the user then logs in)

post.description: Returns the user object plus an access/refresh token pair. The refresh token policy depends on the `X-Client-Platform` header captured here: `android` receives a 100-year non-rotating session, anything else the standard 30-day rotating policy.

200.description: New token pair. External-service tokens always follow the web policy: each refresh returns a NEW refreshToken (rotating); presenting a rotated-out token burns the whole session family (401, all sessions die). Send the newest refreshToken only.

post.description: With the `X-Client-Platform: android` header only the presented refresh token's family is revoked. Otherwise the logout is account-wide: every refresh family is revoked and `token_version` is bumped.

post.summary: Exchange a bot identity for a user token pair (find-or-create)
post.description: Server-to-server. Resolves (provider, external_id) — creating a phone-less, password-less shadow user (account_type 'external') on first contact — and returns a normal token pair for it. The JWT carries the provider as the channel claim, so orders placed with it are stamped order.placed_via (attribution). provider MUST equal the authenticated service's provider. Rate limit: 300 req/min per API key.

external_id.description: Platform user id as seen by the bot

profile.description: Display snapshot stored on the identity; keys first_name/last_name/username feed the generated user name

bot_id.description: Bot username — recorded on the identity's bot_ids

200.description: Token pair; is_new=true when the shadow user was just created

has_phone.description: false for new bot users — bind a phone before checkout/delivery

post.summary: Bind a phone via a shared Telegram/Bale contact
post.description: Requires scope identity:bind_phone AND the service's allowed_phone_methods to include 'contact'. Accepts a contact the user shared about THEMSELVES — contact_user_id must equal external_id (a forwarded contact is refused, code CONTACT_MISMATCH). Binds without OTP; merging is never attempted from this path.

contact_user_id.description: Platform user id carried by the shared contact — MUST equal external_id

post.summary: Send an SMS OTP to bind a phone to the bot identity
post.description: Requires scope identity:bind_phone. Normalizes Iranian numbers (09xxxxxxxxx). Deliberately silent about ownership: whether the number is free is revealed only at verify-otp. A different already-bound phone gets 409 phone_already_set and no SMS; the same phone returns idempotent {already_bound:true}.

409.description: phone_already_set — this identity already has a different phone

post.summary: Verify the OTP and bind the phone (optionally merge accounts)
post.description: Requires scope identity:bind_phone. If the number belongs to a REGISTERED account, the response is 409 phone_taken with can_merge:true — retry with merge:true to merge the shadow's data into the registered account; a successful merge then issues tokens for the registered account. Phone binding is write-once: a bound identity cannot change numbers. Phone is write-once; the response carries a fresh token pair for the final account.

merge.description: Confirm merging when the server answered 409 phone_taken with can_merge

200.description: Phone bound (or merged, or already bound)

409.description: phone_already_set | phone_taken (can_merge:true → retry with merge) | phone_owner_conflict

post.summary: Claim a single-use link code (connect bot identity to a registered site account)
post.description: Requires scope identity:exchange. The user generates a code on the website (POST /api/users/link-code with a normal session) and sends it to the bot. If the bot identity has orders/a cart, the server demands an explicit merge confirmation: 409 MERGE_REQUIRED + can_merge:true — retry with merge:true. Stable codes: 400 LINK_CODE_INVALID, 409 IDENTITY_LINKED_ELSEWHERE / ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE, 503 MERGE_INCOMPLETE (retry same code).

merge.description: Confirm merging the shadow user's data into the registered account

200.description: Identity linked — token pair for the registered account

503.description: MERGE_INCOMPLETE — retry with the same code

post.description: Validation: city, postal_code, and either street or address are required; latitude/longitude must not both be 0 (use GET /api/neshan/reverse to fill them). Persian digits are normalized. The first address is forced default; is_default=true unsets the previous default. Returns the full updated list.

post.summary: Start a gateway payment for an order
post.description: Creates a NEW PaymentAttempt (never overwrites previous attempts), records it on the order and returns the gateway payment page URL — give payUrl to the user. Amount is derived from the order server-side (never trusted from the client); Rials = totalAmount × 10 (SnappPay uses its own conversion). Gateways: zibal (default), digipay (requires the user's phone — falls back to the bound phone), snappay (BNPL; eligibility is checked and can be probed via GET /api/payment/snappay/eligibility). The gateway confirms via its callback; afterwards the bot polls GET /api/orders/{orderId}.

mobile.description: Optional; needed by DigiPay when the user has no bound phone

502.description: Gateway rejected the request (e.g. SnappPay eligibility)

post.description: Looks the order up by zibal_track_id owned by the caller. Verification must match PaymentAttempt.ExpectedAmount — mismatch marks the attempt failed.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from POST /api/users/login (Authorization: Bearer <token>). Admin/Staff gates check the LIVE role in MongoDB on every request.

serviceApiKey.name: X-API-Key
serviceApiKey.description: External service API key (Telegram/Bale/Instagram bots), managed in the admin external-services panel.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

AddressInput.description: models.Address JSON. Persian/Arabic digits in postal_code/phone_number/address/street are normalized server-side.

phone_number.description: Delivery phone for the shipping label

address.description: Full address text — required when street is empty

street.description: Required when address is empty (one of the two)

is_default.description: Sets this address as the default (unsets the previous default); the first address is forced default

ProductListItem.description: One storefront card = ONE COLOR VARIANT of a product. ai_metadata embeddings and search_metadata are never shipped.

variantId.description: Stable color-variant id — cart items key on this

quantity.description: Stock of this size; 0 = sold out

inStock.description: Any size of this color in stock

ProductVariant.description: Color variant (carts and orders key on variant_id)

ProductInput.description: Product create/update body (admin form). variantId is never sent — identity is restored by color+colorName, then list position.

is_active.description: Storefront visibility toggle, not a delete marker

product.description: Product card (id, name, price, originalPrice, mainImages, colorVariants, inStock, weight, image)

warnings.description: Stock/availability problems found while preparing the cart

productId.description: Product _id (list rows carry it as productId)

placed_via.description: Sales channel: web | telegram | ... — stamped from the JWT channel claim of external-service sessions

ReturnRequest.description: Allowed only for delivered+paid orders within delivered_at + 7 days; one pending request per order

ShopCollection.description: Admin-curated bundle of product COLOR VARIANTS (not products)

ExternalService.description: Bot/channel integration. api_key and webhook secrets are returned once at creation/rotation, never again.

TryonTask.description: In-memory task status (tryOnTasks); task ids expire after 5 (finished) / 30 (unfinished) minutes

ExternalUserSummary.description: Safe user shape returned to external services — no addresses, no hashes.

account_type.description: "external" = freshly created shadow user; "registered" = existing site account (after phone bind or link code)

phone.description: Present only when a phone is bound

ExternalAuthResponse.description: Token pair + user summary. The pair follows the web policy: 30-day rotating refresh tokens — store both server-side and refresh via POST /api/users/refresh.

token.description: Access token — send as Authorization: Bearer <token>

refreshToken.description: Rotating refresh token; reuse of a rotated token burns the whole session family

CartVariantInput.description: Which color+size to add. Get variantId/color/colorName/sku from the product's colorVariant.sizes[] rows.

variantId.description: colorVariant.variantId — stable identity of the color variant

product.description: Product card (id, name, price, originalPrice, mainImages, colorVariants, inStock, weight, image)

warnings.description: Stock/availability problems found while preparing the cart

price_at_purchase.description: Informational — the server recomputes the payable total

CheckoutRequest.description: Creates a pending order. It does NOT start payment — afterwards call POST /api/payment/request with the returned order id. Amounts are recomputed and verified server-side.

totalAmount.description: Client-declared total; the payable amount is recomputed server-side

promoCode.description: Promo or negotiated coupon code (TRYN-... / cart-recovery)

payUrl.description: Gateway payment page URL — give it to the user; after payment the gateway calls back this API and the order becomes paid

ErrorBody.description: Standard error body — branch on code, never on the message
